description: This Java source file defines the REST API resource 'OfficesApiResource' for managing offices in the Fineract microfinance platform. It includes endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, downloading templates, and uploading office data. The class uses JAX-RS annotations for RESTful routes and OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: OfficesApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing endpoints for managing office entities, such as listing, creating, updating, and file templates, in the Fineract system.

methods.name: retrieveOffices
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list offices with optional filtering, ordering, and field selection.

methods.name: retrieveOfficeTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for creating new offices with default values and allowed parent options.

methods.name: createOffice
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new office based on supplied JSON data.

methods.name: retrieveOffice
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific office by ID, with optional template options.

methods.name: retrieveOfficeByExternalId
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve office info using an external ID.

methods.name: updateOffice
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing office identified by ID.

methods.name: updateOfficeWithExternalId
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an office identified by an external ID.

methods.name: getOfficeTemplate
methods.description: Provides an Excel template file for bulk import of office data.

methods.name: postOfficeTemplate
methods.description: Handles uploading an Excel file to bulk import office data.
